chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:

key_terms.جَمَاعَةٌ: a congregation; a group praying together
key_terms.عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ: peace be upon him; the honorific used for the Imam

ai.seo_question: What is the minimum number of people needed to form a congregational prayer in Islam?
ai.summary: This hadith states that even a group of two qualifies as a congregation. It indicates the validity and virtue of congregational salat (prayer) even with the minimum number of participants.
